The memory industry is facing yet another antitrust lawsuit and investigation into illegal price fixing and cartel-like behavior as DRAM prices skyrocket 300-700%, depending on which memory you're shopping for. We dig through the 100+ page document for the new lawsuit, cover the history of DRAM industry collusion and cartels, and talk about SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron.
